senses.gloss:
धे €1 P. (धयति, धीत; caus. धापयति; desid. धित्सति)
—1 To suck, drink, drink in, absorb (fig. also); अधाद्वसामधासीच्च
 रुधिरं वनवासिनाम् Bk. 15. 29, 6. 18; Ms. 4. 59; Y. 1. 140.
—2 To kiss; धन्यो धयत्याननम् Gīt. 12.
—3 To suck out, draw or take away.
—4 To appropriate. ━Caus. To suckle, nourish.
